## Terraform Provider for SAP Integration Suite v0.3.0

### Overview

0.3.0 changes how the provider treats anything SAP has not documented. Every
implemented feature now records where its contract comes from, and features
that rest only on a service's `$metadata`, or on operations SAP does not
document, are switched off until the provider block turns them on. The
release also fixes what the September 2026 acceptance runs found in
certificates, key pairs and number ranges, and the Terraform Registry
documentation was rewritten page by page.

0.3.0 adds no resource types. Two changes are breaking. Read "Upgrading from
0.2" before you run `terraform plan`.

### Highlights

- **Opt-in for undocumented functionality.** Experimental and unofficial
  resources, and the undocumented operations of documented resources, need
  `enable_experimental` or `enable_unofficial` in the provider block. A plan
  that needs one without the switch fails with an error that names it.
- **Contract sources.** Each feature is marked as backed by SAP's
  documentation, an official API specification, SAP's own tooling, or only the
  service's `$metadata`. Only an official source allows the status supported;
  `$metadata` alone means unofficial once verified on a tenant. The feature
  data sources return the source and the undocumented operations.
- **Documentation.** Every resource and data source page describes the
  lifecycle (including why an attribute forces replacement), what an import
  recovers, prerequisites and roles, and SAP limitations separately from
  provider limitations. New guides: Getting Started, Importing Existing
  Content, Provider Upgrades, Troubleshooting.

### Upgrading from 0.2

**1. Switches for experimental and unofficial types.** Add them to the provider
block if you use these types; nothing else changes, and state is untouched:

| Type | Switch |
|---|---|
| `sapintegrationsuite_business_data_graph` (resource and data source) | `enable_experimental = true` |
| `sapintegrationsuite_secure_parameter`, `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_runtime_assignments` | `enable_unofficial = true` |

**2. Undocumented operations.** Without `enable_unofficial`, these plans fail
before anything is sent to SAP:

- an in-place update of a message mapping or script collection, and
  `save_as_version` when creating a script collection;
- a changed description of an access policy;
- an update, replacement or destroy of a business data graph.

Number ranges keep working without the switch, but only with the create and
update SAP documents: a refresh keeps the state, every update must change
`current_value_wo_version`, and destroy and import are refused. To keep the 0.2
behavior, set `enable_unofficial = true`. To stop managing a number range
without deleting it, use `terraform state rm`.

```terraform
provider "sapintegrationsuite" {
  enable_experimental = true
  enable_unofficial   = true
}
```

Both switches can also come from `SAP_INTEGRATION_SUITE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL`
and `SAP_INTEGRATION_SUITE_ENABLE_UNOFFICIAL`.

### Fixes

- Replacing a certificate no longer ends in "Provider produced inconsistent
  result after apply".
- Importing a key pair no longer plans a replacement, which would have
  generated a new private key: the subject fields are filled from SAP's subject
  DN, and `signature_algorithm` or `key_algorithm_parameter` set after an
  import are only recorded.
- Number range names are checked against the rule SAP states (letters, digits,
  spaces, underscores) at plan time instead of failing on apply.

### Known limitations

- There is no API proxy resource: the API portal rejected the import that
  SAP's Client SDK sends, even for a bundle it exported itself. It follows once
  the request documented in the official Transport API specification works.
- Integration Assessment has no resources yet.
- Value mapping entries and data types stay unimplemented: tenant checks showed
  that the entry functions do not behave as documented, and data types cannot
  be written with content.
- Edge Integration Cell targeting (`runtime_location_id`) is not supported.

### SAP API references

- Cloud Integration: the Business Accelerator Hub package
  <https://api.sap.com/package/CloudIntegrationAPI/odata>, including the
  Security Content API (<https://api.sap.com/api/SecurityContent>) and the
  Message Store API for number ranges (<https://api.sap.com/api/MessageStore>).
- Classic API Management: <https://api.sap.com/package/APIMgmt/all>.
- Every reference, with the evidence behind each classification:
  [`docs/sap-api-references.md`](https://github.com/Prideth/terraform-provider-sap-integration-suite/blob/master/docs/sap-api-references.md).

### Compatibility

- Terraform 1.5 or later; 1.11 or later for resources with write-only
  attributes (`*_wo`).
- Terraform plugin protocol 6.
